criteria_help.ppk_keep_powered:
Keeps the DUT powered after a run, so its serial port stays available.
**Uncheck before using the Power Profiler app.**
criteria_help.ppk_mode: source_meter: the PPK2 supplies the DUT. ampere_meter: external supply.
criteria_help.ppk_port: PPK2 devices detected now. Rescan after plugging one in.
criteria_help.ppk_power_on: Turns the DUT on when the session opens.
criteria_help.ppk_power_settle_sec: Pause after power on, while the DUT boots.
criteria_help.ppk_source_mv: Output voltage. Required in ampere_meter mode too.

description: Selects the Power Profiler Kit II, its measurement mode and supply voltage, and opens the shared PPK2 session.
help_text:
Place this card before any PPK2 test. It owns the PPK2 session: the device is opened once here and the test modules borrow it.

source_meter: the PPK2 supplies the DUT (LED breathes red). Wire VOUT to VDD_nRF and GND to ground.
ampere_meter: the DUT is powered externally and the PPK2 sits in series (LED breathes blue). Wire VIN and VOUT across the current measurement header.
